label: Mass Casualty Incident
summary: A mass casualty event injures many people at once. An active shooter is someone currently shooting or trying to shoot people.

items.label: Move away from danger and keep others clear if safe
items.body: Stay out of unsafe areas; follow emergency instructions.

items.label: For an active shooter, escape if safe
items.body: Otherwise, lock or block a door, hide, and silence your phone. Fight only as a last resort to survive.

items.label: Once safe, call 911 and keep your hands visible to responders
items.body: Follow school instructions about picking up children.

items.label: Immediate danger or a serious injury?
items.body: Call 911 as soon as you can safely do so.

items.label: Learn how to respond to an active shooter
items.body: Avoid, barricade, and confront only when needed to survive.

items.label: Understand school emergency procedures
items.body: Lockdown, shelter, and evacuation procedures. Wait for school instructions about pickup or reunification.

items.label: Take a free hands-only CPR class
items.body: Public CPR training. Check dates and locations; this program does not provide CPR certification.

items.label: Find bleeding control training in Queens
items.body: Stop the Bleed classes. Confirm the next public class, registration, and any cost.

items.label: Find local first aid and CPR classes
items.link_label: American Red Cross Greater New York
items.body: First aid and CPR training. Class fees and schedules vary.

items.label: Get support after crime or violence
items.body: Confidential support and referrals, 24/7. Call 800-621-4673. Phone translation in more than 25 languages.

items.label: Talk to someone about stress or distress
items.body: Free, confidential mental health support, 24/7. Call or text 988. Phone support in 200+ languages; text and chat in English and Spanish.

items.label: Find a local crime victim advocate
items.body: Victim advocates in precincts. Find the advocate serving your neighborhood.

items.label: Find victim services and possible financial help
items.link_label: New York State Office of Victim Services
items.body: Local providers and possible compensation for eligible crime-related expenses.
